location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

status.provenance: [Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.]

date.provenance: [Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.]

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Beginning January 1, 2025, no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

who.provenance: no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

action.provenance: no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

products.provenance: 'Cosmetic product' means an article for retail sale or professional use intended to be rubbed, poured, sprinkled, or sprayed on, introduced into, or otherwise applied to the human body for cleansing, beautifying, promoting attractiveness, or altering the appearance.

intentionally_added.provenance: 'Intentionally added PFAS' means either of the following: (1) PFAS chemicals that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect on the product. (2) PFAS chemicals that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical.
